messages:
sam-sales: Heads-up — Acme trial tenant (tenant_id: acme-trial-42) is hitting 429s while doing a bulk embeddings import. They started staying under our documented QPS but get bursts that blow past per-route caps. Need quick guidance and (if safe) a short-lived per-route cap bump for the POC.
jamal: Can you paste an example response header from the 429s? Need X-RateLimit headers if present and exact route they call.
sam-sales: Paste from customer: 
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Date: Tue, 03 Mar 2026 16:02:11 GMT
Content-Type: application/json
X-RateLimit-Limit: 120
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
X-RateLimit-Reset: 1677885732
{
  "error": "rate limit exceeded",
  "retry_after": 12
}
They're hitting /v1/embeddings concurrently from a worker pool that bursts when they upload CSVs.
maria: How large are their requests? Are they sending many vectors per call or one vector per call? Also what embedding model?
sam-sales: They send batches of ~1024 inputs in a single request using the text-embedding-3-large model. Internal devs didn't chunk the CSV. Pricing question from them: will chunking up affect token billing?
jamal: 1024 is huge — our per-request token estimation and memory/kv handling can trigger server-side throttles. Recommend chunking to <256 items per request and cap parallelism to 6. Token billing is per input token processed, so total cost is same but smaller requests smooth burst profile.
kevin: Also add client-side exponential backoff on 429s: start at 500ms, double to max 8s with jitter. We can also do a temporary per-route cap increase for this tenant to reduce immediate impact.
sam-sales: Customer wants the temporary bump ASAP — POC demo tomorrow morning PST. Can you do a short lived increase for the trial tenant (stretch X-RateLimit-Limit to 600 for 6 hours) and monitor?
kevin: I'm fine to do a controlled bump if we gate it: enable increased limit only on the embeddings route and set autoscale safety to revert after 6 hours. Need approval from oncall due to cost exposure — tagging quota-bot. @quota-bot please authorize emergency bump for tenant acme-trial-42 to 600 for 6h; owner jamal.
quota-bot: Request recorded: incident/2403-quota-bump-acme-trial-42. Requires one SRE approval and confirmation of customer rate pattern.
jamal: Quick sanity: we should ask them to drop batch size to 128-256 immediately and throttle workers to 4 parallel requests. I'll prepare the temporary route-cap change, but want a sample of their client config (concurrency + retry).
sam-sales: Forwarding their worker config now: concurrency=12, batch_size=1024, no backoff (they retry immediately). They accepted to apply our client changes if we can hold them during demo.
maria: Action items: (1) kevin to apply limited per-route bump for embeddings for tenant acme-trial-42 for 6h with monitoring alerts. (2) jamal to open a short-lived canary rule: drop requests >512 and return 429 with friendly guidance to encourage chunking. (3) sam-sales to get customer to change worker concurrency to 4 and batch_size to 256 + enable backoff.
kevin: I'll run the bump now and post the config diff. Will also attach a grafana panel link for the tenant's token usage.
kevin: Applied: embeddings-route limit for tenant acme-trial-42 = 600 (was 120). Auto-revert scheduled at 6h. Monitoring alert created: tenant_acme_trial_42_rate_spike.
sam-sales: You're heroes, thank you. Confirming customer will change client config in next 30m and we will monitor. :pray:
jamal: After demo, we should add a short doc snippet to presales playbook: "Avoid huge batches for embeddings; chunk + cap concurrency; temporary route bumps are available for demos with SRE approval."
maria: Agreed. Also note for product: consider a server-side graceful throttle that suggests chunk size and estimated retry delay in the 429 body. That would reduce churn on support.
sam-sales: OK closing loop — I'll update the deal thread and send the customer our recommended client snippet and backoff example.

Recommended client backoff snippet for customer:
```
const backoff = (attempt) => Math.min(8000, 500 * 2 ** attempt) + Math.random() * 200;
// on 429: await sleep(backoff(attempt));
```

End of thread.
